triage_stuck_ros.description: Finds all IS_STUCK=1 ROs, ranks by composite escalation score
steps: Derive composite score: (red_flag_count × red_weight) + (yellow_flag_count × yellow_weight) + (DATEDIFF(NOW, LATEST_OBJECT_RUN_DT) × time_weight)
Surface top 10 with stage, org, LOB, time stuck, and escalation recommendation

market_health_report.description: Correlates CSV2 SCS_PERCENT with CSV1 pipeline health flags + stuck RO density for same state
steps: Aggregate CSV1: count Red flags + IS_STUCK=1 count grouped by CNT_STATE
Join with CSV2 SCS_PERCENT and OVERALL_SCS_CNT by MARKET=CNT_STATE
Compute Pearson correlation between flag density and SCS_PERCENT
Flag markets where SCS_PERCENT < 95% OR where Red flag density is rising
Surface: state, SCS_PERCENT, stuck_count, red_flag_density, trend direction

retry_effectiveness_analysis.description: Derives retry lift rate per market, determines if reprocessing recovers transactions or adds latency
steps: CSV1: Group by RO_ID, compare RUN_NO=1 vs MAX(RUN_NO) — derive health flag improvement (Red→Green count)
CSV2: Compute retry lift = NEXT_ITER_SCS_CNT / (NEXT_ITER_SCS_CNT + NEXT_ITER_FAIL_CNT) per market
Correlate CSV1 retry improvement rate with CSV2 NEXT_ITER metrics for same state
Flag markets where retries add duration (DART_REVIEW_DURATION inflates) without resolving IS_STUCK

pipeline_bottleneck_scan.description: Scans all ROs for stage-level duration anomalies, surface systemic bottlenecks
steps: Derive per-RO deviation ratio: actual_duration / AVG_<stage>_DURATION for each of 7 stages
Flag ROs where any deviation ratio > anomaly_multiplier
Group by stage + CNT_STATE + SRC_SYS: find systemic patterns
Rank by: number of affected ROs × avg deviation ratio
Output: stage bottleneck summary with org, LOB, and SRC_SYS breakdowns
